sections.heading: Personality Snapshot
sections.html:
Aquarius is future-facing and group-minded. The core impulse is to spot the pattern, change the rules, and spread the update. At best: principled, inventive, human-centered. At worst: aloof, contrarian for sport, ideas over intimacy. Aim is to pair vision with warmth and delivery.

Aquarius themes hum through the 11th house (friends, networks, causes) balanced with the 5th house (play, romance, creative self). Check aspects to your rulers—e.g., Uranus trine Mercury (lightning ideas), Saturn square Sun (pressure shapes integrity), or Venus conjunction Uranus (love of novelty—needs consent and clarity).

✅ Strengths

  • Independent thinking, pattern vision
  • Loyalty to friends, causes, community
  • Cool under pressure; systems sense

⚠️ Friction Points

  • Detached tone; feelings get footnoted
  • Rebel-without-a-scope-creep
  • All head, no body—forgetting rest

🧭 Growth Moves

  • Translate genius into steps and owners
  • Schedule feelings: name needs early
  • Practice warmth—eye contact, short check-ins

sections.heading: How Aquarius Energy Behaves
sections.html:
Daily Life

  • Finds smarter paths; automates boring parts
  • Chooses friends by values, not vibe alone
  • Comfortable being different in public

Under Stress

  • Goes cool/distant; debates instead of relates
  • Breaks rules without a replacement ready
  • Reset: share the why, pick one next step

Somatic Tells

  • Ankles/circulation react to overthinking
  • Movement + cold-to-warm resets help
  • Breath deepens after a real connection

sections.heading: Love & Sex
sections.html:
Dating an Aquarius

  • Stimulate the mind; invite experiments
  • Share values and plans openly
  • Give space, not silence—check-ins matter

Sex with Aquarius

  • Consent-forward, curious, tech-friendly
  • Novel settings and playful scripts
  • Emotion grows from friendship + freedom

Attachment Triggers

  • Clingy control or vague expectations
  • Values mismatch in friend groups
  • Secrets that exclude the “we”

sections.heading: Work & Money
sections.html:
Natural Lanes

  • Product, data, UX research, community-led work
  • Policy, social impact, future-of-x roles
  • Anything that rewards originality + ethics

Money Style

  • Values-aligned spending; hates waste
  • Prefers low-fee, automated systems
  • Invests in tools, networks, learning

Team Edge

  • Bridges disciplines; connects the right people
  • Sees failure modes early; proposes cleaner rules
  • Holds ideals without losing pragmatism

sections.heading: Growth Practices
sections.html:
Journal Prompts

  • Which rule am I breaking—and what’s my better one?
  • Where can I make space for emotion without losing clarity?
  • Which friend/community needs my attention this week?

Bodywork

  • Walks in crisp air; ankle mobility + balance
  • Breath ladders to exit debate-loop mind
  • Contrast showers to reset nervous system

Ritual

  • Monthly cause check: donate, show up, invite others
  • Weekly friend round-up: 3 pings, 1 plan
  • Office hours for DMs to avoid burnout

sections.heading: Aquarius Decans
sections.html:
Decan I (≈ Jan 20–Jan 29) — Saturn

  • Serious, principled, steady reformer
  • Guard against rigid “shoulds”

Decan II (≈ Jan 30–Feb 8) — Mercury

  • Inventive communicator; network builder
  • Close loops—don’t just brainstorm

Decan III (≈ Feb 9–Feb 18) — Venus

  • Humanist, connector, aesthetic innovator
  • Prioritize intimacy, not only ideals
